moment_text: You wake up
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. White round-headed stick figure with messy hair eyes half-open sitting upright in bed. Morning light through a window. Bold black outlines flat colored bedroom background minimal shading.

moment_text: and the world is different. The phones don't work.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Same stick figure holding up a smartphone showing a cracked screen with a big X over the signal bars. Confused expression. Flat bedroom background bold outlines.

moment_text: The roads are gridlocked with cars that ran out of gas.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Wide shot of a multi-lane road packed with stopped cars end-to-end. A few stick figures standing outside their cars looking around. Flat gray road flat sky bold outlines.

moment_text: You can hear sirens in the distance but they're getting quieter not closer.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure standing on a sidewalk looking toward a distant city skyline. Small sound wave lines (sirens) fading away with arrows pointing outward. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: Here's the thing nobody tells you about the end of the world. It's not the monsters you need to worry about first.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure standing with a shadowy monster silhouette behind them but the monster has a big red X over it. The stick figure is pointing at something else. Flat dark background bold outlines.

moment_text: It's the clock.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Close-up of the stick figure's face looking serious. A large round clock dominates the frame showing 72:00:00. Clock hands ticking. Flat dark background bold outlines.

moment_text: Your body is a machine and machines run out of fuel.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure with a small fuel tank drawn on their chest the gauge needle near empty with a red warning light. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: you have roughly seventy two hours before everything starts going wrong in ways you can't fix by running.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. A large digital countdown timer reading 72:00:00 with the stick figure standing beside it looking up at it. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: Hour one. You're still in shock. Your brain is trying to process information that doesn't make sense yet.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure sitting on the floor knees pulled up hands gripping their head. Dizzy spiral lines and question marks floating around their head. Flat warm beige background bold outlines.

moment_text: This is dangerous because shock makes you do stupid things
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure with a thought bubble showing them running toward a burning building. A big red warning sign next to them. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: like drive toward the city to see what's happening
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure reaching for car keys with a car in the background and a city skyline in the distance. A red X over the car keys. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: or stand outside staring at the sky.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure standing in an open field head tilted back staring straight up at the sky. Other stick figures walking past them purposefully. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: Do none of those things.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure with both arms crossed in a firm stop gesture. Multiple red X marks floating around them blocking different actions. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: The first rule of apocalypse survival is the simplest and the hardest. Stop. Breathe. Think.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure sitting cross-legged on the ground eyes closed hands resting on knees. Three words floating above: STOP BREATHE THINK in bold letters. Flat calm green background bold outlines.

moment_text: Look around you right now and name three things.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure standing in a room with three objects highlighted with glowing circles: a water bottle a backpack and a door. The figure is pointing at them one by one. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: Where are you? What do you have? Who is with you?
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Three panels side by side: a map pin icon (where)
column5: a backpack with items spilling out (what)
column6: and two stick figures standing together (who). Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: That inventory is your entire world now. Treat it like it matters because it does.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure carefully arranging a small pile of items (bottle can flashlight blanket) on the floor like precious treasures. A glowing circle around the pile. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: Hour two through twelve. Water. Not food. Water.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure holding up a glass of water with both hands like a trophy. Below them a plate of food with a red X and the word WATER in big bold letters above. Flat light blue background bold outlines.

moment_text: Your body can survive weeks without eating but only days without drinking
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Two side-by-side panels: left shows a stick figure next to a calendar with 21 days circled (food)
column5: right shows a stick figure next to a clock with only 3 days circled in red (water). Flat split background bold outlines.

moment_text: dehydration will kill you faster than anything else. Find water now.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure urgently turning on a faucet over a glass. A clock in the background with an alarm symbol. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: Tap water might still work for a few hours but don't count on it.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure filling a glass from a kitchen tap. The water flow is thin and sputtering. A question mark above the tap. Flat kitchen background bold outlines.

moment_text: Fill every container you own. Bathtub pots bottles plastic bags. Everything.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure running around a room filling a bathtub cooking pots bottles and plastic bags all with water drops. Motion lines showing urgency. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: If the tap is already dead then you need to think about what's around you.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure standing at a sink turning a dry faucet with no water coming out. The figure is looking around the room thinking. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: Rainwater is your best friend if you can catch it.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure holding a large bucket outside catching rain drops. Rain falling from clouds above. A smile on the figure's face. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: A river or stream works but you'll need to boil it.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure crouching beside a small stream filling a pot. A small fire with a pot on top shown in a thought bubble above. Flat outdoor background bold outlines.

moment_text: And here's a fact that sounds weird until you need it. The water heater in most homes holds thirty to eighty gallons of perfectly clean drinking water.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure kneeling beside a tall cylindrical water heater in a basement. They're turning a valve at the bottom and clean water is flowing into a bucket. A label reads '30-80 gal'. Flat basement background bold outlines.

moment_text: Pop the valve at the bottom and you just solved your biggest problem.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Close-up of the stick figure's hand turning the valve at the bottom of the water heater. Water flowing steadily into a large container. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: Hours twelve through thirty six. Shelter and safety.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure standing in a doorway of a small sturdy building at dusk. One hand on the door frame looking out alertly. Flat purple dusk background bold outlines.

moment_text: You need a place where you can lock a door and control who comes in.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure inside a room turning a deadbolt lock on a door. A small shield icon appears on the door. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: Avoid the obvious places. Schools hospitals gas stations grocery stores.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Four building icons in a row: a school (flag)
column7: a grocery store (cart). Each has a big red X through it. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: Every panicked person who ever watched a movie is heading to those exact spots.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. A large crowd of identical stick figures all rushing toward a bright grocery store building. Our stick figure is walking away in the opposite direction. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: Instead look for the places people forget. The hardware store on the edge of town.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure standing in front of a small hardware store at the edge of a town. The store has a hammer sign. Fewer people around. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: The farm supply depot.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure in front of a large barn-like building with a wheat stalk sign. Tools and supplies visible through the open door. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: The small church with a basement.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure standing beside a small simple church building pointing down at a basement door. A flashlight beam illuminating the stairs going down. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: These places have tools they have supplies and most importantly they have fewer people.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Three small icons: a hammer (tools)
column6: and a single stick figure standing alone (fewer people). Our figure nodding approvingly. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: Hours thirty six through forty eight. Food becomes the priority now.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure with an empty stomach gauge showing a rumbling stomach icon. A clock in the background showing 36+ hours passed. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: Don't look for fancy meals. Look for calories.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Split panel: left shows a fancy plated meal with a red X
column5: right shows a pile of energy bars and nuts with a green checkmark and calorie numbers floating above. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: Canned beans peanut butter crackers rice. Anything that lasts without refrigeration.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure holding four items: a can of beans
column7: and a bag of rice. Each item has a small shelf-life label showing months/years. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: You're not cooking. You're fueling.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure eating directly from a can with a spoon in one hand. A small fuel gauge on their side filling up from empty to full. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: But here's the part most survival guides skip. You need to think about security before you think about breakfast.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure checking a window lock with one hand while a plate of food sits untouched on a table behind them. A shield icon above the window. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: A full pantry means nothing if someone can just walk in and take it.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. A room full of shelves stacked with food. A shadowy stick figure silhouette walking through an unlocked open door toward the shelves. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: Check your doors. Check your windows.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure going from a door to a window checking each lock. Small checkmark icons appearing on each secured entry point. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: Figure out how many ways someone can enter your space and then figure out how to control each one.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Top-down floor plan view of a small room with three entry points marked with red dots. The stick figure standing in the center placing barriers at each entry. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: Hours forty eight through seventy two. This is where the real test begins.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure sitting against a wall looking tired. A large clock showing 48:00:00 behind them. The lighting is dim. Flat muted background bold outlines.

moment_text: The adrenaline is wearing off. You're tired you're sore.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure slumped against a wall with dark circles under their eyes. A battery icon above their head showing red low charge. Flat dim background bold outlines.

moment_text: and the reality of the situation is settling in like a weight on your chest.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure sitting with a large heavy rock labeled 'REALITY' pressing on their chest. Their expression is strained but determined. Flat muted background bold outlines.

moment_text: This is when people make their worst decisions. They give up. They panic.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Two stick figures on either side: one lying on the ground with an X over them (gave up)
column5: one running in circles with chaos lines (panic). Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: They try to contact family members who aren't answering and they waste precious hours watching a dead phone.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure staring at a phone showing 'No Signal' and 0% battery. A clock behind them spinning fast showing hours wasted. A big red X over the scene. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: Don't do that. Accept the situation. Not forever. Just for right now.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure sitting calmly on the floor one hand on the ground head slightly raised. A small 'pause' symbol floating nearby. The figure's expression is peaceful. Flat soft background bold outlines.

moment_text: The person who survives the apocalypse is not the strongest or the smartest.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Three stick figures: one huge and muscular with flexing arms
column5: one wearing a graduation cap with books. Both have question marks above them. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: It's the one who can sit in a quiet room and think clearly while the world falls apart outside.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure sitting calmly in a small room with a glowing lightbulb above their head. Outside the window behind them chaos and fire but the room is peaceful. Flat split background bold outlines.

moment_text: So here's your checklist for the first three days. Water first.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure standing next to a wall-mounted checklist. The first item 'WATER' has a green checkmark next to a water drop icon. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: Then shelter.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. The checklist now shows 'SHELTER' with a green checkmark next to a house icon. The stick figure pointing at it. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: Then food.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. The checklist now shows 'FOOD' with a green checkmark next to a can icon. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: Then security.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. The checklist now shows 'SECURITY' with a green checkmark next to a lock icon. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: Then rest. Not in that exact order if circumstances force you to change it.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. The checklist shows all five items checked: water drop
column8: and bed. The stick figure standing back looking at the complete list. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: That's the skeleton. Build everything else on top of it.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. A simple skeleton diagram of a house with the five checklist items as the foundation beams. The stick figure adding more structure on top. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: And one more thing. When you're ready and only when you're ready start thinking about other people.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure looking out a window toward a distant figure on the road. The expression is thoughtful. A small question mark above their head. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: Lone wolves don't survive the long winter.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. A lone stick figure standing in a cold snowy landscape arms wrapped around themselves shivering. Snowflakes falling. Flat cold blue background bold outlines.

moment_text: Groups do.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. A group of four stick figures sitting around a small campfire in a sheltered area. They look warm and safe. Flat warm background bold outlines.

moment_text: But you want to choose your group carefully and you want to be ready before you knock on anyone's door.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure standing in front of a door hand raised to knock but pausing. They're looking down at their own supplies checking they're ready. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: Offer something. Skills supplies information.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure holding out three items toward another figure: a wrench (skills)
column6: and a folded map (information). Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: Never show up empty handed and scared.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Side by side: left shows a stick figure with empty hands and a scared face being turned away at a door. Right shows a figure with a small bag approaching and being welcomed in. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: The first seventy two hours are about staying alive.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure standing strong with a large shield in front of them. The number 72 in bold behind them. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: Everything after that is about deciding what kind of person you're going to be in the world that comes next.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure standing at a fork in a road. One path goes dark and jagged
column5: the other is lit and straight. The figure is looking forward deciding. Flat split background bold outlines.

moment_text: And that decision matters more than any supply run you'll ever make.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. A large glowing heart icon in the center with the stick figure's hand over it. Supply items (cans tools) faded in the background. Flat warm background bold outlines.

moment_text: Stay calm. Stay ready.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure in a ready stance: feet planted
column6: alert but calm expression. Two words floating: CALM and READY. Flat background bold outlines.

moment_text: And remember that every single day you wake up breathing is a day you won.
visual_prompt: Stick-figure cartoon 16:9. Stick figure standing in a doorway morning light streaming in. Looking out at a calm horizon with a small sun rising. Confident pose slight smile. A small trophy icon in the corner. Flat warm golden background bold outlines.
